title: Rate-Based Emissions Trading with Overlapping Policies: Insights from Theory and an Application to China
venue: NBER Working Paper / World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Jurisdictions employing emissions trading systems (ETSs) to control emissions often utilize other environmental or energy policies as well, including policies to support renewable energy and reduce energy consumption. Interactions with these other policies lead to different outcomes from what might be predicted by examining the policies separately. The prior literature considering policy interactions has focused mainly on the case where the ETS is cap and trade. This paper extends the literature by examining the outcomes under a wide range of ETSs (including several forms of tradable performance standards) and overlapping policies (including various renewable subsidies and electricity consumption taxes). An analytical model demonstrates that the impacts of overlapping policies on allowance prices, emissions, and electricity output depend critically on the nature of the ETS. A numerical general equilibrium model tailored to China’s economy explores the implications for the cost-effectiveness of emissions reductions. Results indicate that overlapping policies that reduce cost-effectiveness under cap and trade can significantly enhance cost-effectiveness under tradable performance standards. The model predicts that under the current and planned designs for China’s ETS, which sets differentiated tradable performance standards for emitters, implementing renewable portfolio standards and accounting for indirect emissions from electricity consumption are both beneficial. Together they can reduce the cost of achieving the national emissions target by 20-30 percent over the interval 2020-2035. Transitioning to uniform benchmarks for emitting power generators could save another 10-15 percent. The findings highlight the importance of coordinating the designs of emissions trading systems with the overlapping policies. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 使用排放交易体系（ETS）控制排放的司法管辖区，通常还会同时使用其他环境或能源政策，包括支持可再生能源和减少能源消费的政策。这些其他政策之间的相互作用，会导致与单独考察各项政策时所预测的结果不同。已有文献在考虑政策相互作用时，主要关注ETS为总量控制与交易的情形。本文拓展了该文献，考察了一系列更广泛的ETS（包括多种形式的可交易绩效标准）以及重叠政策（包括各类可再生能源补贴和电力消费税）下的结果。一个分析模型表明，重叠政策对配额价格、排放和电力产出的影响，关键取决于ETS的性质。一个专门针对中国经济构建的数值一般均衡模型，探讨了这些政策对减排成本有效性的影响。结果表明，在总量控制与交易下会降低成本有效性的重叠政策，在可交易绩效标准下则可以显著提升成本有效性。模型预测，在中国ETS当前及规划的设计（即对排放者设定差异化的可交易绩效标准）下，实施可再生能源配额制以及核算电力消费所产生的间接排放，两者都是有益的。二者结合可以使在2020至2035年间实现国家减排目标的成本降低20%至30%。将发电排放者转向统一基准，还可再节省10%至15%。研究结果凸显了协调排放交易体系设计与重叠政策的重要性。《NBER工作论文》的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Business Cycles and Environmental Policy: A Primer
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: We study the relationship between business cycles and the design and effects of environmental policies, particularly those with economy-wide significance like climate policies. First, we provide a brief review of the literature related to this topic, from initial explorations using real business-cycle models to New Keynesian extensions, open-economy variations, and issues of monetary policy and financial regulations. Next, we provide a list of the main findings that emerge from this literature that are potentially most relevant to policy makers, including the impacts of policy on volatility and how to design policy to adjust to cycles. Finally, we propose several important remaining research questions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究经济周期与环境政策的设计及效果之间的关系，尤其是气候政策等具有全经济范围影响的政策。首先，我们简要回顾了该主题的相关文献，内容涵盖从早期运用实际经济周期模型的探索，到新凯恩斯主义的扩展、开放经济的变体，以及货币政策和金融监管问题。接着，我们列出了这一文献中可能与政策制定者最为相关的主要发现，包括政策对波动性的影响，以及如何设计政策以适应周期变化。最后，我们提出了若干重要的待研究问题。

title: How Is the U.S. Pricing Carbon? How Could We Price Carbon?
abstract: Economists have for decades recommended that carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases be taxed—or otherwise priced—to provide incentives for their reduction. The United States does not have a federal carbon tax; however, many state and federal programs to reduce carbon emissions effectively price carbon—for example, through cap-and-trade systems or regulations. There are also programs that subsidize reductions in carbon emissions. At the 2022 meetings of the American Economic Association, the Society for Benefit-Cost Analysis brought together five well-known economists—Joe Aldy, Dallas Burtraw, Carolyn Fischer, Meredith Fowlie, and Rob Williams—to discuss how the United States does, in fact, price carbon and how it could price carbon. Maureen Cropper chaired the panel. This paper summarizes their remarks.
abstract_zh: 几十年来，经济学家一直建议对二氧化碳及其他温室气体征税，或以其他方式为其定价，以激励减排。美国没有联邦碳税；然而，许多州和联邦的减排计划实际上为碳定价，例如通过总量控制与交易体系或法规实现。还有一些计划对减排进行补贴。在2022年美国经济学会年会上，效益—成本分析学会邀请了五位知名经济学家——Joe Aldy、Dallas Burtraw、Carolyn Fischer、Meredith Fowlie和Rob Williams——讨论美国实际上是如何为碳定价的，以及美国可以如何为碳定价。Maureen Cropper主持了该小组。本文总结了他们的发言。

title: Potential Impacts and Challenges of Border Carbon Adjustments
Green Innovation and Economic Growth in a North-South Model
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: If one region of the world switches its research effort from dirty to clean technologies, will other regions follow To investigate this question, this paper builds a North-South model that combines insights from directed technological change and quality-ladder endogenous growth models with business-stealing innovations. While North represents the region with climate ambitions, both regions have researchers choosing between clean and dirty applications, and the resulting technologies are traded. Three main results emerge: (i) In the long-run, if North's research and development (R&D) sector is large enough, researchers in South will follow the switch from dirty to clean R&D in North, motivated by the growing value of clean markets. (ii) If the two regions direct research effort toward different sectors and the outputs of the two sectors are gross substitutes, then the long-run growth rates in both regions are lower than if the global research effort were invested in one sector. (iii) If North's government induces its researchers to switch to clean R&D through clean technology subsidies, the welfare-maximizing choice for South is to ensure that all of its researchers switch too, unless the social discount rate is high. The last result is true even if South's R&D sector is large.
abstract_zh: 如果世界上某一地区将其研发努力从肮脏技术转向清洁技术，其他地区是否会跟随？为探讨这一问题，本文构建了一个南北模型，该模型结合了定向技术变革和质量阶梯内生增长模型的见解，并纳入了商业窃取型创新。北方代表具有气候雄心的地区，两个地区的研究人员都要在清洁与肮脏的应用之间进行选择，而所产生的技术可以进行交易。模型得出三个主要结论：（i）从长期看，如果北方的研发部门足够大，南方的研究人员将会跟随北方从肮脏研发转向清洁研发，原因是清洁市场价值的增长。（ii）如果两个地区将研究努力导向不同的部门，且这两个部门的产出是总替代品，那么两个地区的长期增长率都将低于全球研究努力全部投向一个部门时的增长率。（iii）如果北方政府通过清洁技术补贴促使其研究人员转向清洁研发，那么对南方而言，福利最大化的选择是确保其所有研究人员也都转向清洁研发，除非社会贴现率很高。即使南方的研发部门规模很大，最后这一结论依然成立。

title: Intensity-Based Rebating of Emission Pricing Revenues
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Carbon-pricing policies worldwide are increasingly coupled with direct or indirect subsidies where emissions pricing revenues are rebated to the regulated entities. This study analyzes the incentives created by two novel forms of rebating that reward additional emission intensity reductions: one given in proportion to output (intensity-based output rebating) and another that rebates a share of emission payments (intensity-based emission rebating). These forms are contrasted with output-based rebating, abatement-based rebating, and lump-sum rebating. Given the same emission price, intensity-based output rebating incentivizes the most intensity reductions, while abatement-based rebating causes the most output reductions, and output-based rebating puts the least pressure on output (and emissions); intensity-based emissions rebating lies in between these, by implicitly subsidizing emissions while incentivizing intensity reductions. The study supplements partial equilibrium theoretical analysis with numerical simulations to assess the performance of different mechanisms in a multisector general equilibrium model that accounts for economy-wide market interactions.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，碳定价政策越来越多地与直接或间接补贴相结合，即将排放定价收入返还给受监管主体。本研究分析了两种新型返还形式所创造的激励，它们奖励额外的排放强度降低：一种是按产出比例给予的返还（基于强度的产出返还），另一种是返还部分排放支付额（基于强度的排放返还）。这两种形式与基于产出的返还、基于减排量的返还以及一次性总额返还进行了对比。在相同的排放价格下，基于强度的产出返还对强度降低的激励最强，基于减排量的返还造成的产出下降最多，而基于产出的返还对产出（以及排放）的压力最小；基于强度的排放返还则介于其中，它通过隐性补贴排放，同时激励强度降低。本研究以局部均衡理论分析为补充，并在一个考虑全经济市场互动的多部门一般均衡模型中进行数值模拟，以评估不同机制的表现。

title: Fishy SPS Measures? The WTO's Korea - Radionuclides Dispute
More Birds Than Stones: A Framework for Second-Best Energy and Climate Policy Adjustments
Political Viability, Market-Based Standards, and Climate Policy
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management

title: The Green New Deal and the Future of Carbon Pricing
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: In this article, we discuss the future of U.S. climate policy within the context of the Green New Deal (GND). The GND has many features and this article is not meant to provide a comprehensive evaluation of all components of it. Rather, we focus on carbon pricing and whether it, rather than mandates and standards, should feature more centrally in the future of U.S. climate policy. We orient our discussion around issues related to theoretical aspects of different climate policy instruments and empirical evidence on their performance. We consider the efficiency and effectiveness of different approaches, their distributional aspects and how these relate to the increasingly important environmental justice priorities, and their political feasibility.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们在绿色新政（GND）的背景下讨论美国气候政策的未来。绿色新政包含诸多内容，本文并非旨在对其所有组成部分作全面评估。相反，我们聚焦于碳定价，探讨在美国气候政策的未来中，碳定价是否应当比强制性规定与标准发挥更为核心的作用。我们围绕不同气候政策工具的理论层面以及其绩效的实证证据展开讨论。我们考察不同方案的效率与有效性、它们的分配效应，以及这些分配效应如何与日益重要的环境正义优先事项相关联，并考察其政治可行性。

title: Tools and Policies to Promote Decarbonization of the Electricity Sector
abstract: This chaptersummarisesboth marketand non-market-basedpolicies andtoolsavailable forencouragingdecarbonisationof the electricity sector. Market-based policiesinclude carbon pricing, through a carbon tax on electricity generation or a cap-and-trade program on emissions, and second-best tradable standards, which include emissions intensity standards, clean energy standards, and renewable portfolio standards. Popular non-market, technology-specific policymechanismsdiscussed include targeting specific technologies through subsidies, or discouraging the use of dirtier resources, such as coal, through a mandated phase-out. Policy options for encouraging energy efficiency in the power sector to reduce emissions are also explored. Policies that price carbon are more economically efficient than other, particularly non-market policies but can be politically challenging. Since multiple policies are often used simultaneously,interactions between these various market and non-marketpoliciesare discussed. Examples are drawn from experiences in several countries, including parts of Europe, the US, Asia, and South America.
abstract_zh: 本章总结了可用于促进电力部门脱碳的市场型与非市场型政策和工具。市场型政策包括碳定价（通过对发电征收碳税，或对排放实行总量控制与交易计划），以及次优的可交易标准，其中包括排放强度标准、清洁能源标准和可再生能源配额制。常被讨论的非市场性、技术特定的政策手段包括通过补贴支持特定技术，或通过强制淘汰来限制煤炭等较脏资源的使用。本章还探讨了为减少排放而提高电力部门能效的政策选项。与其他政策，特别是非市场性政策相比，给碳定价在经济上更具效率，但在政治上可能颇具挑战。由于多种政策常常同时使用，本章还讨论了各种市场型和非市场型政策之间的相互作用。文中的例子取材于若干国家的经验，包括欧洲部分地区、美国、亚洲和南美洲。

title: Baptists and Bootleggers in the Biodiesel Trade: EU-Biodiesel (Indonesia)
How to Avoid History Repeating Itself: The Case for an EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) Price Floor Revisited
abstract: Several years of very low allowance prices in the EU emissions trading scheme (ETS) have motivated calls to introduce a price floor to correct potential underlying distortions and design flaws, including (i) the political nature of allowance supply and related credibility issues, (ii) potential myopia of market participants and firms, and (iii) waterbed and rebound effects resulting from policy interactions. In the wake of the recent EU ETS reform, allowance prices have sharply increased. This raises the question of whether the case for introducing a price floor in the EU ETS remains valid. We argue that such a price floor, also adopted in several other greenhouse gas cap-and-trade systems worldwide, remains an important improvement in the design of the system, as long as the above-mentioned distortions and design flaws persist. An EU ETS price floor can safeguard against these issues and provides more explicit guidance on the minimum allowance price policymakers consider acceptable. Either as a complement or substitute to the current Market Stability Reserve (MSR), a price floor would thus make the EU ETS less prone to future revision in case of unexpectedly low prices. We identify and confront four prominent arguments against the introduction of an EU ETS price floor. Key policy insights An EU ETS price floor would be an important institutional innovation enhancing political and economic stability, and predictability of the EUA priceThe recent Market Stability Reserve (MSR) reform has not removed the need for a carbon price floor. Introducing an element of price responsiveness into the so far purely quantitative design of the EU ETS would help to preserve its integrityIn contrast to conventional wisdom, legal analysis reveals that an EU ETS price floor can be legally feasiblePolitical support for a carbon price floor is gaining traction across Europe
abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）配额价格长期处于极低水平，这促使人们呼吁引入价格下限，以纠正潜在的深层扭曲和设计缺陷，包括：（i）配额供给的政治性质及相关的可信度问题；（ii）市场参与者和企业可能存在的短视；以及（iii）政策互动所产生的“水床效应”和反弹效应。在欧盟排放交易体系近期改革之后，配额价格大幅上涨。这引出一个问题：在欧盟排放交易体系中引入价格下限的理由是否依然成立。我们认为，只要上述扭曲和设计缺陷依然存在，这样的价格下限（其他多个温室气体总量控制与交易体系也已采用）仍是体系设计上的重要改进。欧盟排放交易体系的价格下限可以防范这些问题，并就政策制定者认为可接受的最低配额价格提供更明确的指引。作为现行市场稳定储备（MSR）机制的补充或替代，价格下限将使欧盟排放交易体系在价格意外走低时，较少需要进行事后修订。我们梳理并回应了反对引入欧盟排放交易体系价格下限的四个主要论点。主要政策见解：欧盟排放交易体系价格下限将是一项重要的制度创新，有助于增强政治与经济稳定性，并提升EUA价格的可预测性。近期市场稳定储备（MSR）改革并未消除对碳价格下限的需求。在迄今纯粹数量化的欧盟排放交易体系设计中引入价格响应的要素，将有助于维护其完整性。与传统观点相反，法律分析表明，欧盟排放交易体系价格下限在法律上是可行的。欧洲各地对碳价格下限的政治支持正在增强。

title: Kill Bill or Tax: An Analysis of Alternative CO2 Price Floor Options for EU Member States
abstract: Several EU member states are exploring options for setting minimum domestic carbon prices within the EU Emission Trading System (ETS). First, a “TAX” policy would introduce a carbon tax equal to the difference between the prevailing ETS price and the targeted minimum price. Second, a national auction reserve price would “KILL” allowances by invalidating them until the ETS price equalled the national minimum price. Third, a government could require domestic overcompliance and “BILL” covered entities for extra allowances per ton of emissions, thereby increasing demand for allowances and pulling up the ETS price. We explore the implications of these policy options on national and ETS-wide carbon prices, revenues from emissions allowances, emissions, and economic welfare. We find that a national government’s preferred unilateral policy will depend on the extent to which it values the fiscal benefits of revenues, which favor TAX or to a lesser degree BILL, versus climate benefits, which favor KILL and also BILL, particularly for jurisdictions with more emissions to leverage for overcompliance. Our analysis can be generalized to other multilateral cap-and-trade systems where participants pursue more stringent internal emission pricing through unilateral policies.
abstract_zh: 若干欧盟成员国正在探索在欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）内设定国内碳价格最低值的方案。第一，“TAX”（税）方案将征收一项碳税，其数额等于现行ETS价格与目标最低价格之间的差额。第二，“KILL”（注销）方案由国家拍卖保留价格构成，通过使配额失效，直至ETS价格等于国家最低价格为止。第三，政府可以要求国内超额履约，并对受管制实体每吨排放的额外配额进行“BILL”（收费），从而增加对配额的需求并拉高ETS价格。我们探讨了这些政策选项对国家和ETS整体碳价格、排放配额收入、排放量及经济福利的影响。研究发现，一国政府偏好的单边政策，取决于其更看重财政收益还是气候收益：财政收益更有利于TAX，其次是BILL；而气候收益则更有利于KILL，也更有利于BILL，特别是对那些拥有更多可用于超额履约的排放量的司法管辖区而言。我们的分析可以推广到其他多边总量控制与交易体系，在这些体系中，参与者通过单边政策对内部排放实施更严格的定价。

title: Developing Guidance for Implementing Border Carbon Adjustments: Lessons, Cautions, and Research Needs from the Literature
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Policymakers are often reluctant to implement strong carbon pricing for fear of disadvantaging domestic industries and offshoring emissions-intensive activities. Border carbon adjustment (BCA) would address such carbon leakage concerns by using trade measures to ensure that products from foreign producers facing lower (or no) carbon prices are on equal footing with domestically produced goods. Despite intuitive economic appeal, BCA requires numerous challenging regulatory choices, including its scope of applicability (i.e., which policies, goods, sectors, countries), the methodology for assessing the carbon content of products, the type and price of the adjustment, scenarios requiring modification, and how the resulting revenues will be used. Each of these choices has economic and environmental implications that influence the effectiveness of the BCA, as well as nuanced technical, legal, and political consequences that must be considered. In particular, the design of any BCA must comport with international agreements governing trade and climate policy responsibilities. This article reviews the economic and legal literature on BCA, provides guidance for the design and implementation of BCAs, and identifies research priorities.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者往往不愿实施力度较大的碳定价，原因在于担心这会使国内产业处于不利地位，并导致排放密集型活动向海外转移。边境碳调整（BCA）旨在通过贸易措施来应对此类碳泄漏担忧，确保来自碳价格较低（或无碳价格）的外国生产商的产品，与国内生产的商品处于同等地位。尽管其在经济上颇具吸引力，但BCA需要作出众多具有挑战性的监管选择，包括其适用范围（即哪些政策、商品、部门和国家）、产品碳含量的评估方法、调整的类型和价格、需要修改的情景，以及所产生收入的使用方式。上述每一项选择都具有经济和环境影响，从而影响BCA的有效性，同时也带来需要考虑的、细微的技术、法律和政治后果。特别是，任何BCA的设计都必须符合规范贸易与气候政策责任的国际协定。本文回顾了关于BCA的经济学和法学文献，为BCA的设计与实施提供指导，并指出了研究的优先方向。

title: Horizontal Equity Effects in Energy Regulation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Choices in energy regulation, particularly whether and how to price externalities, can have widely different distributional consequences both across and within income groups. Traditional welfare theory focuses largely on effects across income groups; such "vertical equity" concerns can typically be addressed by a progressive redistribution of emissions revenues. In this paper, we review alternative economic perspectives that give rise to equity concerns within income groups, or "horizontal equity," and suggest operational measures. We then apply those measures to a stylized model of pollution regulation in the electricity sector. In addition, we look for ways to present the information behind those measures directly to stakeholders. We show how horizontal equity concerns might overshadow efficiency concerns in this context.
abstract_zh: 能源监管中的选择，特别是是否以及如何为外部性定价，可能会在不同收入群体之间以及同一收入群体内部产生截然不同的分配后果。传统福利理论主要关注不同收入群体之间的效应；此类“纵向公平”问题通常可以通过对排放收入进行累进再分配来解决。本文中，我们回顾了可能引发同一收入群体内部公平关切（即“横向公平”）的替代经济学视角，并提出了可操作的衡量方法。随后，我们将这些衡量方法应用于电力部门污染监管的一个程式化模型。此外，我们还探索了如何将这些度量背后的信息直接呈现给利益相关者。我们表明，在这一背景下，横向公平的关切可能会掩盖效率问题。

title: The Legal and Economic Case for an Auction Reserve Price in the EU Emissions Trading System
abstract: When it was launched in 2005, the European Union emissions trading system (EU ETS) was projected to have prices of around €30/ton CO2 and to be a cornerstone of the EU's climate policy. The reality was a cascade of falling prices, a ballooning privately held emissions bank, and a decade of low prices providing inadequate incentive to drive investment in the technologies and innovation necessary to achieve long-term climate goals. The European Commission responded with administrative measures, including postponing the introduction of allowances (backloading) and using a quantity-based criterion for regulating future allowance sales (the market stability reserve); although prices are beginning to recover, it is far from clear whether these measures will adequately support the price into the future. In the meantime, governments have been turning away from carbon pricing and adopting overlapping regulatory measures that reinforce low prices and further undermine the confidence in market-based approaches to addressing climate change. The solution in other carbon markets has been the introduction of a reserve price that would set a minimum price in allowance auctions. Opponents of an auction reserve price in the EU ETS have expressed concern that a minimum auction price would interfere with economic operations in the market or would be tantamount to a tax, which would trigger a decision rule requiring unanimity among EU Member States. This Article reviews the economic and legal arguments for and against an auction reserve price. Our economic analysis concludes that an auction reserve price is necessary to accommodate overlapping policies and for the allowance market to operate efficiently. Our legal analysis concludes that an auction reserve price is not a "provision primarily of a fiscal nature," nor would it "significantly affect a Member State's choice between different energy sources." We describe pathways through which a reserve price could be introduced.
abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）于2005年启动时，预计价格约为每吨CO2 30欧元，并将成为欧盟气候政策的基石。然而现实是，价格一路下跌，持有排放配额的“排放储存”膨胀，且十年低价未能提供足够的激励以推动实现长期气候目标所需的技术投资与创新。欧盟委员会对此采取了行政措施，包括推迟配额发放（回拨）以及采用基于数量的标准来调节未来的配额拍卖（即市场稳定储备）；尽管价格已开始回升，但目前尚不清楚这些措施能否在未来充分支撑价格。与此同时，各国政府开始背离碳定价，转而采用相互叠加的监管措施，这些措施强化了低价格，并进一步削弱了人们对以市场为基础的应对气候变化方式的信心。其他碳市场的解决办法是引入拍卖保留价格，为配额拍卖设定最低价格。对欧盟排放交易体系设置拍卖保留价格的反对者担心，最低拍卖价格会干扰市场的经济运行，或者实质上等同于一种税，而这将触发需要欧盟成员国一致同意的决策规则。本文回顾了支持和反对拍卖保留价格的经济与法律论据。我们的经济分析得出结论：拍卖保留价格对于协调相互叠加的政策以及使配额市场有效运行是必要的。我们的法律分析得出结论：拍卖保留价格不属于“主要具有财政性质的条款”，也不会“显著影响成员国在不同能源来源之间的选择”。我们描述了引入保留价格的可行路径。

title: How Trade Sensitive Are Energy-Intensive Sectors?
abstract: For most governments looking to implement climate policy—and for interest groups looking to influence it—the effect of unilateral greenhouse gas regulation on employment, production, and emissions represents an overarching concern. Critical to improving analysis of climate policy, implications for energy-intensive, trade-exposed sectors are better empirical estimates of trade sensitivities. Ex ante analysis of climate policy and carbon leakage relies heavily on economic simulations of global trade. We estimate parameters related to trade sensitivity to help identify sectors at risk for carbon leakage and to calibrate the models used to evaluate policy alternatives for addressing these problems.
abstract_zh: 对于大多数寻求实施气候政策的政府，以及试图影响气候政策的利益集团而言，单边温室气体监管对就业、生产和排放的影响，是一个首要的关切。要改进对气候政策的分析，关键在于对能源密集型、贸易暴露型部门的影响给出更好的实证估计，即贸易敏感性。对气候政策和碳泄漏的事前分析在很大程度上依赖于全球贸易的经济模拟。我们估计了与贸易敏感性相关的参数，以帮助识别面临碳泄漏风险的部门，并用于校准那些用来评估应对这些问题的政策选项的模型。

title: Strategic Technology Policy as a Supplement to Renewable Energy Standards
Trade Between Mass- and Rate-Based Regulatory Regimes: Bad for Emissions?
Balancing the Carbon Budget for Oil: The Distributive Effects of Alternative Policies
Disease Risk and Market Structure in Salmon Aquaculture
Environmental Protection for Sale: Strategic Green Industrial Policy and Climate Finance
abstract: Industrial policy has long been criticized as subject to protectionist interests; accordingly, subsidies to domestic producers face disciplines under World Trade Organization agreements, without exceptions for environmental purposes. Now green industrial policy is gaining popularity as governments search for low-carbon solutions that also provide jobs at home. The strategic trade literature has largely ignored the issue of market failures related to green goods. I consider the market for a new environmental good (like low-carbon technology) whose downstream consumption provides external benefits (like reduced emissions). Governments may have some preference for supporting domestic production, such as by interest-group lobbying, introducing a political distortion in their objective function. I examine the national incentives and global rationales for offering production (upstream) and deployment (downstream) subsidies in producer countries, allowing that some of the downstream market may lie in nonregulating third-party countries. Restraints on upstream subsidies erode global welfare when environmental externalities are large enough relative to political distortions. Climate finance is an effective alternative if political distortions are large and governments do not undervalue carbon costs. Numerical simulations of the case of renewable energy indicate that a modest social cost of carbon can imply benefits from allowing upstream subsidies.
abstract_zh: 产业政策长期以来一直因受到保护主义利益的影响而饱受批评；因此，依据世界贸易组织协定，对国内生产者的补贴受到纪律约束，且并无针对环境目的的例外。如今，随着各国政府在寻求低碳解决方案的同时希望提供国内就业，绿色产业政策正日益受到欢迎。战略性贸易文献在很大程度上忽略了与绿色产品相关的市场失灵问题。本文考察了一种新的环境产品（如低碳技术）的市场，其下游消费带来外部收益（如减排）。政府可能偏好支持国内生产，例如通过利益集团游说，从而在其目标函数中引入政治扭曲。我考察了生产国对上游（生产）补贴和下游（部署）补贴所产生的国家激励与全球理由，同时考虑到部分下游市场可能位于不实施监管的第三方国家。当环境外部性相对于政治扭曲足够大时，对上游补贴的约束会侵蚀全球福利。若政治扭曲很大且政府并未低估碳成本，气候融资是一种有效的替代方案。针对可再生能源的数值模拟表明，当社会碳成本适度时，允许上游补贴可能带来收益。

title: Environmental and Technology Policy Options in the Electricity Sector: Are We Deploying Too Many?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Myriad policy measures aim to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the electricity sector, promote generation from renewable sources, and encourage energy efficiency (EE). Prior literature has argued that overlapping policies reduce the efficiency of emissions markets, absent other market failures. We extend the model of Fischer and Newell to incorporate knowledge spillovers for both advanced and conventional renewable energy technologies, as well as imperfections in demand for EE investments. EE undervaluation can justify interventions and raises the importance of fully pricing the social costs of electricity, making policies (like renewable subsidies) that lower electricity prices less desirable. Innovation market failures justify some technology policies, particularly correcting R&D incentives, but aggressive deployment policies seem unlikely to enhance welfare when placed alongside sufficient emissions pricing. Even with multiple market failures, emissions pricing remains the most cost-effective option for reducing emissions. However, technology-oriented policies can involve less redistribution of surplus.
abstract_zh: 大量政策措施旨在减少电力部门的温室气体排放、促进可再生能源发电，并鼓励能源效率（EE）。已有文献认为，在不存在其他市场失灵的情况下，相互叠加的政策会降低排放市场的效率。我们扩展了Fischer和Newell的模型，纳入了先进和传统可再生能源技术的知识溢出，以及能效投资需求中的不完全性。能效被低估可以为政策干预提供正当性，并提高全面为电力的社会成本定价的重要性，使得那些降低电价的政策（如可再生能源补贴）变得不那么可取。创新市场失灵为某些技术政策提供了正当性，特别是纠正研发激励，但在存在充分排放定价的情况下，激进的部署政策似乎不太可能增进福利。即使存在多重市场失灵，排放定价仍然是减少排放最具成本效益的选择。然而，面向技术的政策可能涉及较少的剩余再分配。

title: Robust Technology Policy Against Emission Leakage: The Case of Upstream Subsidies
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Canada - Renewable Energy: Implications for WTO Law on Green and Not-So-Green Subsidies
abstract: In the first dispute on renewable energy to come to WTO dispute settlement, the domestic content requirement of Ontario’s feed-in tariff was challenged as a discriminatory investment-related measure and as a prohibited import substitution subsidy. The panel and Appellate Body agreed that Canada was violating the GATT and the TRIMS Agreement. But the SCM Article 3 claim by Japan and the European Union remains unadjudicated, because neither tribunal made a finding that the price guaranteed for electricity from renewable sources constitutes a ‘benefit’ pursuant to the SCM Agreement. Although the Appellate Body provides useful guidance to future panels on how the existence of a benefit could be calculated, the most noteworthy aspect of the new jurisprudence is the Appellate Body’s reasoning that delineating the proper market for ‘benefit’ analysis entails respect for the policy choices made by a government. Thus, in this dispute, the proper market is electricity produced only from wind and solar energy.
abstract_zh: 在首个进入WTO争端解决程序的可再生能源争议中，安大略省上网电价制度中的国产化要求遭到质疑，被认为是一项歧视性的投资相关措施，并构成被禁止的进口替代补贴。专家组和上诉机构均认为加拿大违反了《关税与贸易总协定》（GATT）和《与贸易有关的投资措施协定》（TRIMS）。但日本和欧盟提出的《补贴与反补贴措施协定》第3条主张仍未经裁决，因为两个裁决机构均未认定可再生能源电力的保证价格构成《补贴与反补贴措施协定》意义上的“利益”。尽管上诉机构为未来专家组如何计算利益是否存在提供了有益指导，但此次新判例法中最值得注意的方面，是上诉机构的推理：界定“利益”分析的恰当市场，需要尊重政府所作的政策选择。因此，在本案中，恰当的市场是仅由风能和太阳能生产的电力市场。

title: Competing Environmental Labels
abstract: We study markets in which consumers prefer green products but cannot determine the environmental quality of any given firm's product on their own. A nongovernmental organization (NGO) can establish a voluntary standard and label products that comply with it. Alternatively, industry can create its own standard and label. We compare the stringency of these two types of labels, and study their strategic interaction when they coexist. We find that even with error‐free labels, environmental benefits may be smaller with two labels than with the NGO label alone, and we characterize when label competition is more likely to be environmentally beneficial.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了这样一类市场：消费者偏好绿色产品，但无法单凭自身判断任一企业产品的环境质量。非政府组织（NGO）可以制定自愿性标准，并为符合该标准的产品贴上标签。另外，行业也可以制定自己的标准并进行标识。我们比较了这两类标签的严格程度，并研究了它们在并存时的战略互动。我们发现，即使标签不存在误差，与仅有非政府组织标签的情况相比，两种标签并存时带来的环境效益可能更小；我们还刻画了标签竞争在何种情况下更有可能有利于环境。

title: Cost-Effective Unilateral Climate Policy Design: Size Matters
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Output-Based Allocation of Emissions Permits for Mitigating the Leakage and Competitiveness Issues for the Japanese Economy
Environmental Macroeconomics: Environmental Policy, Business Cycles, and Directed Technical Change
abstract: Environmental economics has traditionally fallen in the domain of microeconomics, but approaches from macroeconomics have recently been applied to studying environmental policy. We focus on two macroeconomic tools and their application to environmental economics. First, real-business-cycle models can incorporate pollution and pollution policy and can be used to answer several questions. For example, how should environmental policy adjust to business cycles? How do different types of policies fare in a context with business cycles? Second, endogenous technological growth is an important component of environmental policy. Several studies ask how policy can be designed both to tackle emissions directly and to influence the adoption of clean technologies. We focus on these two aspects of environmental macroeconomics but emphasize that there are many other potential applications.
abstract_zh: 环境经济学传统上属于微观经济学领域，但宏观经济学的方法近来也被应用于环境政策研究。我们聚焦于两种宏观经济工具及其在环境经济学中的应用。首先，实际经济周期模型可以纳入污染和污染政策，并可用于回答若干问题。例如，环境政策应如何随经济周期调整？不同类型的政策在经济周期背景下表现如何？其次，内生技术增长是环境政策的重要组成部分。若干研究探讨了如何设计政策，既直接应对排放，又影响清洁技术的采用。我们侧重于环境宏观经济学的这两个方面，但同时强调还有许多其他潜在应用。

title: Climate Policy and Fiscal Constraints: Do Tax Interactions Outweigh Carbon Leakage?
abstract: Climate policymaking faces twin challenges of carbon leakage and public sector revenue requirements. A large literature advocates the use of carbon dioxide (CO2) pricing and recycling the revenues to lower distorting taxes as a way to minimize costs. In this paper, we explore the implications of labor tax interactions for the cost-effectiveness of border adjustments and other measures to cope with leakage. We find that, for plausible values of labor supply elasticities, the cost savings from revenue recycling are significant — from 15 to 25 percent. The cost savings from anti-leakage measures are generally smaller, but also significant, particularly for small coalitions or more binding reduction targets. Tax interactions further enhance the cost savings from border adjustments, but make other measures like rebates or exemptions less attractive.
abstract_zh: 气候政策制定面临两大挑战：碳泄漏与公共部门的收入需求。大量文献主张采用二氧化碳（CO2）定价，并将收入用于降低扭曲性税收，以此作为最小化成本的途径。本文探讨了劳动税的相互作用对边境调整及其他应对泄漏措施的成本有效性的影响。我们发现，在劳动供给弹性的合理取值下，收入回收带来的成本节约十分可观，达15%至25%。反泄漏措施带来的成本节约通常较小，但也颇为显著，特别是对于小型联盟或更具约束力的减排目标而言。税收的相互作用进一步增强了边境调整带来的成本节约，但却使返还或豁免等其他措施的吸引力下降。

title: Climate Policy, Uncertainty, and the Role of Technological Innovation
Comparing Policies to Combat Emissions Leakage: Border Carbon Adjustments versus Rebates
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We explore conditions determining which anti-leakage policies might be more effective complements to regulation of domestic greenhouse gas emissions. We consider four policies that could be combined with unilateral emissions pricing to counter effects on international competitiveness: a border charge on imports, a border rebate for exports, full border adjustment, and domestic output-based rebating. Each option faces different potential legal hurdles in international trade law; each also has different economic impacts. While all can support competitiveness, none is necessarily effective at reducing global emissions. Nor is it possible to rank the options; effectiveness depends on the relative emissions rates, elasticities of substitution, and consumption volumes. We illustrate these results with simulations for the energy-intensive sectors of three different economies- the United States, Canada, and Europe. Although most controversial, full border adjustment is usually most effective, but output-based rebating for key manufacturing sectors can achieve many of the gains.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了哪些条件决定了哪些反泄漏政策可能是对国内温室气体排放监管更为有效的补充。我们考虑了四种可与单边排放定价相结合、以抵消对国际竞争力影响的政策：对进口征收的边境税、对出口给予的边境退税、完全边境调整，以及国内基于产出的返还。每种选项在国际贸易法中面临不同的潜在法律障碍；它们的经济影响也各不相同。虽然所有选项都能支持竞争力，但没有一项必然能有效减少全球排放。此外，也无法对这些选项进行排序；其有效性取决于相对排放率、替代弹性和消费量。我们以美国、加拿大和欧洲三个不同经济体的能源密集型部门的模拟来说明这些结果。尽管最具争议，但完全边境调整通常最为有效；然而，针对关键制造部门的基于产出的返还，也能够实现许多相同的收益。

title: A Bio-Economic Model of Community Incentives for Wildlife Management Under CAMPFIRE
Automobile Fuel Economy Standards: Impacts, Efficiency, and Alternatives
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This paper discusses fuel economy regulations in the United States and other countries. We first describe how these programs affect the automobile market, including their impacts on fuel use and other dimensions of the vehicle fleet. We then review different methodologies for assessing the costs of fuel economy regulations and discuss what the results of these methodologies imply for policy. Following that, we compare the welfare effects of fuel economy regulations to those of fuel taxes and assess whether or not these two policies can be complements. Finally, we review arguments for transitioning away from fuel economy regulations towards a "feebate" system.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了美国及其他国家的燃油经济性法规。我们首先描述这些计划如何影响汽车市场，包括它们对燃料使用以及车队其他方面的影响。随后，我们回顾了评估燃油经济性法规成本的不同方法，并讨论这些方法的结果对政策意味着什么。接着，我们比较了燃油经济性法规与燃油税的福利效应，并评估这两种政策是否可以互补。最后，我们梳理了从燃油经济性法规转向“费税结合”（feebate）制度的理由。

title: Emissions Targets and the Real Business Cycle: Intensity Targets versus Caps or Taxes
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: For reducing greenhouse gas emissions, intensity targets are attracting interest as a flexible mechanism that would better allow for economic growth than emissions caps. For the same expected emissions, however, the economic responses to unexpected productivity shocks differ. Using a real business cycle model, we find that a cap dampens the effects of productivity shocks in the economy on all variables except for the shadow value of the emissions constraint. An emissions tax leads to the same expected outcomes as a cap but with greater volatility. Certainty-equivalent intensity targets maintain higher levels of labor, capital, and output than other policies, with lower expected costs and no more volatility than with no policy.
abstract_zh: 为减少温室气体排放，强度目标作为一种灵活机制正受到关注，相较于排放上限，它能更好地兼顾经济增长。然而，在预期排放量相同的情况下，经济体对意外生产率冲击的反应有所不同。利用一个真实经济周期模型，我们发现，排放上限会抑制经济中生产率冲击对所有变量的影响，但排放约束的影子价值除外。排放税所带来的预期结果与排放上限相同，但波动性更大。确定性等价的强度目标，相较于其他政策，能维持更高水平的劳动力、资本和产出，预期成本更低，且其波动性并不高于无政策情形。

title: Market Power and Output-Based Refunding of Environmental Policy Revenues
The Role of Trade and Competitiveness Measures in US Climate Policy
abstract: We review the proposed measures for addressing competitiveness and carbon leakage concerns in recent US climate policy legislation. For eligible energy-intensive, trade-exposed sectors, output-based rebates would initially dampen cost increases; later, border adjustments would ensure that imports face comparable cost burdens. Both measures can in theory enhance the economic efficiency of carbon reduction efforts, but both pose some interesting economic and practical trade-offs. This paper discusses our recent research into the welfare and carbon leakage effects of using output-based allocation and trade measures in conjunction with climate policies.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了近期美国气候政策立法中为应对竞争力和碳泄漏问题而提出的措施。对于符合条件的能源密集型、贸易暴露型部门，基于产出的退税将在初期缓和成本上升；随后，边境调整将确保进口产品面临可比的成本负担。这两项措施在理论上都能提高碳减排努力的经济效率，但二者都带来了一些有趣的经济与实践上的权衡。本文讨论了我们近期关于将基于产出的配额分配与贸易措施结合应用于气候政策时，其福利效应与碳泄漏效应的研究。

title: Combining Policies for Renewable Energy: Is the Whole Less Than the Sum of Its Parts?
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Since the energy crisis in the 1970s and later the growing concern for climate change in the 1990s, policymakers at all levels of government and around the world have been enthusiastically supporting a wide range of incentive mechanisms for electricity from renewable energy sources (RES-E). Motivations range from energy security to environmental preservation to green jobs and innovation, and measures comprise an array of subsidies to mandates to emissions trading. But do these policies work together or at cross-purposes? To evaluate RES-E policies, one must understand how specific policy mechanisms interact with each other and under what conditions multiple policy levers are necessary. In this article, we review the recent environmental economics literature on the effectiveness of RES-E policies and the interactions between them, with a focus on the increasing use of tradable quotas for both emissions reduction and RES-E expansion.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪70年代的能源危机，以及此后90年代对气候变化日益增长的关切以来，世界各地各级政府的政策制定者都热烈支持一系列针对可再生能源发电（RES-E）的激励机制。动机包括能源安全、环境保护、绿色就业和创新，所采取的措施从补贴、强制性配额到排放交易，不一而足。但这些政策是相互配合，还是相互抵触？要评估可再生能源发电政策，必须理解具体的政策机制如何相互作用，以及在何种条件下需要多种政策杠杆。在本文中，我们回顾了近期关于可再生能源发电政策有效性及其相互作用的环境经济学文献，重点关注为减排和扩大可再生能源发电而日益增多地使用的可交易配额。

title: Does Trade Help or Hinder the Conservation of Natural Resources?
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Trade exerts important influences on the exploitation and protection of natural resources. Indeed, recognition of this influence is codified in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, which allows exceptions to treaty obligations for measures “relating to the conservation of exhaustible natural resources,” motivates the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species, and underlies the Convention on Biological Diversity. Trade impacts operate through several channels. Trade liberalization changes relative prices, which affects exploitation incentives. Trade can also have broader effects, such as impacts on labor markets and incomes, which may affect demand for resource-intensive products—or for ecosystem services. Trade interacts with, and can influence, the institutions governing the management of natural resources. Finally, trade can also introduce threats to ecosystems, in the form of invasive species. All of these potential impacts pose special challenges for the conservation of renewable resources, which inherently involves dynamic economic and ecological processes. This article reviews and takes stock of the lessons from the recent economics literature on the links between trade and the conservation of natural resources.
abstract_zh: 贸易对自然资源的开发与保护具有重要影响。事实上，这种影响已被写入《关税与贸易总协定》，该协定允许对“与保护可耗竭自然资源相关”的措施作出对条约义务的例外规定；它也催生了《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》，并构成《生物多样性公约》的基础。贸易的影响通过若干渠道发生。贸易自由化改变了相对价格，从而影响开发激励。贸易还可能产生更广泛的影响，例如对劳动力市场和收入的影响，进而影响对资源密集型产品或生态系统服务的需求。贸易与管理自然资源的制度相互作用，并可能影响这些制度。最后，贸易也可能以外来入侵物种的形式对生态系统构成威胁。所有这些潜在影响都为可再生资源的保护带来了特殊挑战，因为其本身涉及动态的经济与生态过程。本文回顾并总结了近期经济学文献中关于贸易与自然资源保护之间联系的经验教训。

abstract: Individual countries are in the process of legislating responses to the challenges posed by climate change. The prospect of rising carbon prices raises concerns in these nations about the effects on the competitiveness of their own energy-intensive industries and the potential for carbon leakage, particularly leakage to emerging economies that lack comparable regulation. In response, certain developed countries are proposing controversial trade-related measures and allowance allocation designs to complement their climate policies. Missing from much of the debate on trade-related measures is a broader understanding of how climate policies implemented unilaterally (or subglobally) affect all countries in the global trading system. Arguably, the largest impacts are from the targeted carbon pricing itself, which generates macroeconomic effects, terms-of-trade changes, and shifts in global energy demand and prices; it also changes the relative prices of certain energy-intensive goods. This paper studies how climate policies implemented in certain major economies (the European Union and the United States) affect the global distribution of economic and environmental outcomes, and how these outcomes may be altered by complementary policies aimed at addressing carbon leakage.
abstract_zh: 各国正在立法应对气候变化带来的挑战。碳价格上涨的前景引发了这些国家的担忧：一是对本国能源密集型产业竞争力的影响，二是碳泄漏的可能性，尤其是泄漏到缺乏可比监管的新兴经济体。作为回应，某些发达国家正在提出具有争议的贸易相关措施和配额分配设计，以补充其气候政策。在关于贸易相关措施的辩论中，所缺失的往往是对单边（或次全球）实施的气候政策如何影响全球贸易体系中所有国家的更广泛理解。可以说，最大的影响来自有针对性的碳定价本身，它产生了宏观经济效应、贸易条件变化，以及全球能源需求和价格的转变；同时它也改变了某些能源密集型商品的相对价格。本文研究了主要经济体（欧盟和美国）实施的气候政策如何影响全球经济与环境结果的分布，以及这些结果如何可能因旨在应对碳泄漏的补充政策而改变。

title: Understanding Errors in EIA Projections of Energy Demand
abstract: This paper investigates the potential for systematic errors in the Energy Information Administration's (EIA) widely used Annual Energy Outlook, focusing on the near- to midterm projections of energy demand as measured in physical quantities. Overall, based on an analysis of the EIA's 22-year projection record, we find a fairly modest but persistent tendency to underestimate total energy demand by an average of 2 percent per year over the one- to five-year projection horizon after controlling for projection errors in gross domestic product, oil prices, and heating/cooling degree days. For the 14 individual fuels/consuming sectors routinely reported by the EIA, we observe a great deal of directional consistency in the error patterns over time, ranging up to 7 percent per year. Electric utility renewables, electric utility natural gas, transportation distillate, and residential electricity all show significant biases, on average, across the full five year projection horizon examined. Projections for certain other fuels/consuming sectors have significant unexplained errors for selected time horizons. Independent evaluation of this type can be useful for validating ongoing analytic efforts and for prioritizing future model revisions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国能源信息署（EIA）广泛使用的《年度能源展望》中系统性误差的可能性，重点关注以实物量衡量的能源需求的近中期预测。总体而言，基于对EIA二十二年预测记录的分析，我们发现，在控制了国内生产总值、油价和供暖/制冷度日数的预测误差之后，EIA存在一种虽然幅度适中但持续存在的倾向：在一至五年的预测期内，平均每年低估能源总需求2%。对于EIA常规报告的14种单一燃料/消费部门，我们观察到误差模式随时间呈现出很高的方向一致性，年均偏差最高可达7%。电力公用事业可再生能源、电力公用事业天然气、运输用馏分油以及居民用电，在整个五年预测期内平均都显示出显著的偏差。某些其他燃料/消费部门在特定预测期内也存在显著的无法解释的误差。这类独立评估有助于验证持续进行的分析工作，并为确定未来模型修订的优先次序提供参考。

Output-Based Allocation of Emissions Permits for Mitigating Tax and Trade Interactions
abstract: The allocation of tradable emissions permits has important efficiency as well as distributional effects when tax and trade distortions are taken into account. We compare different rules for allocating carbon allowances within sectors (lump-sum grandfathering, output-based allocation (OBA), auctioning) and among sectors (historical emissions or value-added shares). The output subsidies implicit in OBA mitigate tax interactions, unlike grandfathering. OBA with sectoral distributions based on value added is similar to revenue recycling with auctioning. OBA based on historical emissions supports heavier polluters, more effectively counteracting carbon leakage, but at higher welfare costs. Less energy-intensive sectors are also sensitive to allocation rules. (JEL Q 53)
abstract_zh: 在考虑税收和贸易扭曲的情况下，排放许可的分配会产生重要的效率与分配效应。我们比较了在部门内部（一次性总额分配、基于产出的配额分配（OBA）、拍卖）以及部门之间（依据历史排放或增加值份额）分配碳配额的不同规则。与一次性总额分配不同，OBA中隐含的产出补贴可以缓和税收的相互作用。以增加值为部门分配依据的OBA，与拍卖收入的收入回收类似。以历史排放为依据的OBA会支持排放较重的企业，从而更有效地抵消碳泄漏，但福利成本更高。能源密集度较低的部门也对分配规则较为敏感。（JEL Q 53）

title: Multinational Taxation and International Emissions Trading
abstract:
Many studies have shown that the activities of multinational corporations are quite sensitive to differences in income tax rates across countries. In this paper I explore the interaction between multinational taxation and abatement activities under an international emissions permit trading scheme. Four types of plans are considered: (1) a single domestic permit system with international offsets; (2) separate national permit systems without trade; (3) separate national permit systems with limited offsets; and (4) an international permit trading system. For each plan, I model the incentives for the multinational firm to choose abatement activities at home and abroad and to transfer emissions credits between parent and subsidiary.
Limits on trading across countries restrict efficiency gains from abatement, as is well known. But I show furthermore that if available offset opportunities are limited to actual abatement activities, those activities are more susceptible to distortions from incentives to shift taxable income. Transfer pricing rules can limit but not always eliminate these distortions. In a system of unlimited international trading, abatement is efficiently allocated across countries, but tax shifting can still be achieved through intrafirm transfer pricing. From the basis of efficiency for both environmental and tax policies, the best design is an international permit trading system with transparent, enforceable transfer pricing rules.
abstract_zh:
许多研究表明，跨国公司的活动对各国之间所得税税率的差异相当敏感。本文探讨了跨国税收与国际排放许可交易体系下减排活动之间的相互作用。本文考虑了四类方案：（1）单一国内许可体系，并允许国际抵消；（2）各国分别实行不交易的许可体系；（3）各国分别实行、但允许有限抵消的许可体系；（4）国际许可交易体系。对于每种方案，我建立了模型，分析跨国企业在国内外选择减排活动以及在母公司与子公司之间转移排放信用的激励。
跨国交易的限制会限制减排的效率收益，这一点众所周知。但我进一步表明，如果可获得的抵消机会仅限于实际的减排活动，那么这些活动更容易受到为转移应税所得而产生的激励所造成的扭曲。转让定价规则可以限制、但未必能完全消除这些扭曲。在不受限制的国际交易体系中，减排在各国之间实现了有效配置，但通过企业内部的转让定价仍可实现税收转移。从环境政策和税收政策的效率角度来看，最佳设计是一个具有透明且可执行转让定价规则的国际许可交易体系。

Using Emissions Trading to Regulate U.S. Greenhouse Gas Emissions: An Overview of Policy Design and Implementation Issues
abstract: In Kyoto in 1997, the U.S. government agreed that between 2008 and 2012 it would limit average annual emissions of greenhouse gases (GHGs) to seven percent below 1990 levels. As participants in the climate policy debate consider various means by which limits on U.S. GHG emissions might be undertaken in the wake of the Kyoto agreement there is considerable interest but also some confusion about how a GHG trading program could be organized and operated in practice. In this paper, we address several aspects of policy design for a U.S. system, such as who and what is covered by regulation, the organization of the trading system, how carbon permits are allocated, and how a system could be initiated and changed over time.
abstract_zh: 1997年在京都，美国政府同意在2008至2012年间，将其年均温室气体排放量限制在1990年水平以下7%。随着气候政策辩论的参与者在《京都议定书》签署后考虑以各种方式对美国温室气体排放施加限制，人们对于如何在实践中组织和运营温室气体交易计划既有相当兴趣，也存在一些困惑。本文探讨了美国体系政策设计的若干方面，例如：监管覆盖的主体和对象、交易体系的组织方式、碳排放许可如何分配，以及该体系如何启动并随时间进行调整。
